how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-winterspring-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:969:obj:0: Collect 4 Frostmaul Shards for Witch Doctor Mau'ari in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:969:details:0: Ah, I can tell just by lookin' at ya -- you be wantin' to make a lucky charm. Mau'ari always knows!
rows.quest:969:details:1: BTo da south. you'll find a canyon, an' giants made a' solid ice. The giants sometimes be carryin' dem, but ya can always gather da shards yerself from da canyon. These shards have a powerful reflective quality.
rows.quest:969:details:2: BBring back 4 frostmaul shards, and my lucky charm will be yours.
rows.quest:969:completion:0: Ahh, yes... I will make da charm for ya now. Just you wait!
rows.quest:975:obj:0: Speak to Witch Doctor Mau'ari again in a moment to receive the lucky charm.
rows.quest:975:details:0: Now, before I give ya dis charm, I better explain how ta use it.
rows.quest:975:details:1: BIf you carry da charm with ya, you'll find dat certain items will drop from creatures ya fight. If you don't have da charm with you, you won't find them. Understand?
rows.quest:975:details:2: BYou'll know these special items by the name -- they be called E'ko. If you find any of these items, just bring dem to ol' Mau'ari, and she help ya out.
rows.quest:975:details:3: BWait here while I fix your charm.
rows.quest:975:completion:0: Here it is, ⟦1⟧. Remember, ya have ta carry it with you. Why don't ya head back to ⟦E2⟧, an' see what ya be findin' there?
rows.quest:977:obj:0: Collect 2 Pristine Yeti Horns for ⟦E3⟧ Rumplesnicker in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:977:details:0: Now that I have what I need to cover the mechanical moving parts, I only need one other thing. Well, actually two. Two horns!
rows.quest:977:details:1: BThe ice thistle patriarchs and matriarchs have the largest horns, so of course, those are the ones I want. That type of yeti inhabits a cave to the southeast. There are plenty of them there; you shouldn't have any problem finding them.
rows.quest:977:details:2: BRemember, I only want the best looking ones -- no beat up or broken horns, please!
rows.quest:977:completion:0: I can't wait to show my friends! Now, just wait a moment while I attach these...
rows.quest:3783:obj:0: Collect 10 Thick Yeti Furs for ⟦E3⟧ Rumplesnicker in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:3783:details:0: My friends are always coming up with great ideas. I've never felt like I could match them... until today! I just drew up the plans for something great! If you promise not to tell, I'll let you in on the secret...
rows.quest:3783:details:1: BI'm going to make a mechanical yeti! Not only are my friends sure to be freaked out when they see it, but when they get over that, I know they'll be impressed!
rows.quest:3783:details:2: BI need thick yeti fur from the ice thistle yeti to start with. Will you help? You'll find them to the southeast.
rows.quest:3783:completion:0: These furs are perfect, ⟦2⟧. We're off to a great start here!
rows.quest:4809:obj:0: Bring 8 Uncracked Chillwind Horns to Felnok Steelspring.
rows.quest:4809:details:0: I have most of what Tinkee needs, but I'm missing one important component, and that's chillwind horns. The horns of the chillwind chimaera in ⟦E2⟧ are a concentrated source of cold, but only pristine, uncracked horns will do! I'll need a supply of those to complete Tinkee's order.
rows.quest:4809:details:1: BBring me the uncracked chillwind horns, and I'll prepare a package for Tinkee.
rows.quest:4809:completion:0: These are good specimens. They're packed with cold! Let me get some gloves on, then pack them along with the other things Tinkee needs...
rows.quest:4810:obj:0: Bring Felnok's Package to Tinkee Steamboil in the ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:4810:details:0: Ok, everything is prepared and packed and ready for transport! Good luck in your journey, and make sure you tell Tinkee that she owes me!
rows.quest:4810:completion:0: You brought them! Great! I'll get to work right away! Thanks a ton, ⟦3⟧!
rows.quest:4810:completion:1: BYou've been so helpful to me, I might need you for even more important tasks later...
rows.quest:4842:obj:0: Follow Donova Snowden's instructions, then report back.
rows.quest:4842:details:0: To tell you the truth, although there are no volcanoes here in ⟦E2⟧, I believe that there are far more threatening reasons for these hot springs...
rows.quest:4842:details:1: BWell, I think you'll want to see it for yourself. You'll need to travel the length of ⟦E2⟧, and head to the very south. When the air becomes thick and muggy, and the sky turns dark, you'll have found what I believe to be the source of the hot springs.
rows.quest:4842:details:2: BHave a look. I'm sure you'll have many questions when you return.
rows.quest:4842:completion:0: Yes, the demons there in Darkwhisper Gorge; I believe it is their presence that is affecting the land in this way. I am going to continue observing the hot springs here and see if I learn anything more.
rows.quest:4842:completion:1: BI'd wait until you are a bit stronger if you have plans of heading farther into Darkwhisper Gorge.
rows.quest:4861:obj:0: Locate Jaron Stoneshaper's wrecked camp and supplies in southern ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:4861:details:0: Hey there, ⟦4⟧! I was chased from my camp in southern ⟦E2⟧ by some bloodthirsty wildkin! Well, I suppose I got too close to something the wildkin were guarding.
rows.quest:4861:details:1: BI barely managed to get away safely; I fear a buddy of mine wasn't as lucky. Would you mind braving the wildkin and heading to the camp? I really need my supplies, and I'd also like to get back the amulet I unearthed yesterday at the dig site.
rows.quest:4861:completion:0: A severely damaged crate stands out among the rest of the destroyed belongings at the camp...
rows.quest:4863:details:0: Looking around, you don't see much that Jaron could want here. However, you do notice that the crate you found has been smashed open, almost as if this was what the wildkin were after...
rows.quest:4863:details:1: BLooking to the east, you can barely make out an abandoned wagon. Perhaps you might find Jaron's things there. It's worth a look.
rows.quest:4863:completion:0: Approaching the wagon, it doesn't appear that there is much more here for Jaron. But, looking on the ground, you notice some crates that look undamaged, despite being half-buried in the snow.
rows.quest:4864:obj:0: Pick up Jaron's Supplies from the snow, then find the wildkin that stole the amulet Jaron spoke of.
rows.quest:4864:obj:1: BBring Jaron's Supplies and the Blue-feathered Amulet to Jaron Stoneshaper at the lodge in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:4864:details:0: After inspecting the contents of the box, you decide that Jaron could make use of the tools and other items inside. However, there is no sign of the amulet.
rows.quest:4864:details:1: BIt appears that the wildkin inhabit the lands to the north and east of here, so you decide that the next step is to face the creatures and reclaim the amulet from them.
rows.quest:4864:completion:0: Well, I expected to hear as much, lad. I figured that the crazed beasts destroyed all of my belongings...
rows.quest:4864:completion:1: BBut you did find my tools, and most importantly, the amulet! I wonder why the wildkin so fiercely defended this item... In any case, I'll think twice before heading their way again!
rows.quest:4882:obj:0: Take the Blue-feathered Necklace to Trull Failbane at Bloodvenom Post.
rows.quest:4882:details:0: You are unsure of the significance of the necklace that fell from the neck of the recently-slain wildkin. It glows brightly, slowly fading in and out.
rows.quest:4882:details:1: BTrull Failbane might be able to tell you more, since his knowledge of the wildkin seems extensive. Perhaps you should ask him about it.
rows.quest:4883:obj:0: Take the Blue-feathered Necklace to Nara Wildmane.
rows.quest:4883:details:0: While I do possess much knowledge about the owlbeasts you defeated in ⟦E2⟧, I am not very learned on the subject of the magics they wield. But I do believe I know of one that would be able to examine the necklace and most likely tell you what it is.
rows.quest:4883:details:1: BNara Wildmane in ⟦E5⟧ is an expert in this field; see her. Good luck, ⟦5⟧.
rows.quest:4883:completion:0: The energy of this necklace, ⟦6⟧. I believe that it has only one source.
rows.quest:4883:completion:1: B<Nara closes her eyes and is quiet for a moment.>
rows.quest:4883:completion:2: BThe wildkin, now misguided and confused, were once not so. They once had a purpose, and were guided to serve. The night elf goddess ⟦E6⟧ created these creatures to guard her most sacred areas.
rows.quest:4883:completion:3: BWhile this fact may seem like it holds little value; I urge you to look deeper.
rows.quest:4883:completion:4: BYou will learn, in time. Thank you for bringing this to me, ⟦7⟧.
rows.quest:4901:obj:0: Protect Ranshalla while she attempts to reactivate the Altar of ⟦E6⟧. Report your findings to Erelas Ambersky in Rut'theran Village.
rows.quest:4901:details:0: At the very top of the ridge lies what I believe to be an altar of the goddess ⟦E6⟧. From what I can tell, we need to light the five torches in each cave, and then we will be able to access the altar directly.
rows.quest:4901:details:1: BI transcribed some incantations carved into the stone in the ancient ruins of Kel'Theril, which I believe are the secret to unlocking the altar. I'll need your help to light each torch, while I recite the spell.
rows.quest:4901:details:2: BIf we are successful, you'll be able to report our findings to Erelas!
rows.quest:4901:completion:0: Did you meet up with Ranshalla?
rows.quest:4902:obj:0: Speak with Arch ⟦E7⟧ Fandral Staghelm in ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:4902:details:1: BI have always wondered about the truth... Well, you must share this knowledge, definitely! Go to Arch ⟦E7⟧ Fandral Staghelm right away -- you'll find him in ⟦E8⟧, in the Cenarion Circle. Explain to him what happened, just the same as you told me. I'm sure he will be just as interested!
rows.quest:4902:completion:0: Do not hesitate; tell me why you have come.
rows.quest:4902:completion:2: BThank you for bringing this straight to me; it is always best to go right to the top... But... Yes. The druids of the Cenarion Circle have known of the Wildkin for some time. That they are pets of ⟦E6⟧, and were chosen to guard the most sacred of places.
rows.quest:4902:completion:3: BSo while this isn't news, I definitely compliment you on your effort. Here, take this -- it is something that seems suitable for such a deed.
rows.quest:5054:obj:0: Storm Shadowhoof at ⟦E1⟧ in ⟦E2⟧ wants you to kill Ursius.
rows.quest:5054:details:0: In the snowy mountains of ⟦E2⟧, to the northwest, a skilled hunter stalks his prey... I speak of Ursius of the shardtooth bears, an agile and clever beast.
rows.quest:5054:details:1: BI send you now against him. He roams the sloping hills to the northwest of ⟦E1⟧. Find and hunt him, before he discovers your intent.
rows.quest:5054:details:2: BAll that have gone up against Ursius have quickly found themselves to be the prey, and he, the hunter. Stay on your guard.
rows.quest:5054:completion:0: This was no easy task, yet you have excelled. But do not be too quick to think you have impressed me, ⟦9⟧.
rows.quest:5055:obj:0: Storm Shadowhoof at ⟦E1⟧ in ⟦E2⟧ wants you to kill Brumeran.
rows.quest:5055:details:0: Swift, and clever, Brumeran glides silently across the snowy landscape of southern ⟦E2⟧. But do not let her graceful appearance convince you that she is harmless. All that cross her pay considerably, and often with their own lives.
rows.quest:5055:details:1: BSeek out Brumeran of the chillwind among the chimera. Defeat her, then return again to me.
rows.quest:5055:completion:0: Yes. You have returned. I believe now that you are a true ⟦10⟧ by nature. You have faced the most ferocious of creatures and have returned, surpassing my expectations.
rows.quest:5055:completion:1: BYou are now ready for my final request.
rows.quest:5056:obj:0: Storm Shadowhoof at ⟦E1⟧ in ⟦E2⟧ wants you to defeat Shy-Rotam.
rows.quest:5056:details:0: In northern ⟦E2⟧, great cats assemble around a large landmark called Frostsaber Rock. The leader of these cats is known by the name Shy-Rotam. Defeating the matriarch of the frostsabers would grant you much respect in the eyes of your fellow ⟦11⟧.
rows.quest:5056:details:1: BGo again to the harsh wilds, and once there, gather sacred meat from the frostsabers. Find the stone of Shy-Rotam, and place it there. Placing the meat of her kin before her will summon Shy-Rotam, in anger.
rows.quest:5056:details:2: BBe ready for her fury, and defeat her.
rows.quest:5056:completion:0: You have proven both your strength and your determination. Many more challenges await you, but I have already shown you as much as I am able.
rows.quest:5057:obj:0: Bring Storm Shadowhoof's Marker to Melor Stonehoof in ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:5057:details:0: Before you spoke to me, ⟦13⟧, I had heard of your endeavors... that you had an unyielding desire to prove yourself, that you had an exceptional ability as a ⟦14⟧, and I now know these things to be the truth.
rows.quest:5057:details:1: BThose that excel as you do are worthy of recognition. Take this marker to a friend of mine in ⟦E5⟧ named Melor Stonehoof. I'm sure he will remember you, and what you accomplished so long ago. Speak to him of you recent victories, and do not ever forget what you have accomplished today.
rows.quest:5057:completion:0: We learn from our life experiences, ⟦15⟧. From what this marker says, I am sure that you have only become stronger and wiser as a result of yours. You have grown much since we last spoke.
rows.quest:5057:completion:1: BTake this in remembrance of the difficult tasks you have accomplished as a ⟦16⟧ ⟦17⟧, and know that you will always have my respect and admiration.
rows.quest:5082:obj:0: Donova Snowden in ⟦E2⟧ wants you to kill 8 Winterfall Pathfinders, 8 Winterfall Den Watchers, and 8 Winterfall Totemics.
rows.quest:5082:details:0: I came to ⟦E2⟧ to investigate the Frostfire Hot Springs. I've noticed that the water seems to have ...strange qualities. I haven't yet been able to discover the source, and to tell you the truth, I've had some difficulty lately, due to the Winterfall furbolg.
rows.quest:5082:details:1: BThey seem to be drawn to the springs, just as I am. They have become extremely protective of the water, and won't let me come near the two larger springs to the north of here.
rows.quest:5082:details:2: BI'd like to continue my studies, so won't you help me?
rows.quest:5082:completion:0: Thanks so much, ⟦18⟧! Now I can get back to work here.
rows.quest:5082:completion:1: BDid you find anything of interest at the Winterfall camp?
rows.quest:5083:obj:0: Bring the Empty Firewater Flask to Donova Snowden in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:5083:details:0: This vial that you picked up from the Winterfall furbolg is empty, but you can detect a few drops of a strange green liquid inside; it almost glows.
rows.quest:5083:details:2: BDonova Snowden would probably be able to tell you more, since she has been camped by the hot springs in ⟦E2⟧ for some time now.
rows.quest:5083:completion:0: You got this from the Winterfall?
rows.quest:5084:obj:0: Search the ⟦E9⟧ furbolg camp in northern ⟦E10⟧ for a clue.
rows.quest:5084:details:0: This greenish liquid... it reminds me a bit of the sludge I saw when traveling through ⟦E10⟧. And I have seen some Winterfall Runners passing into Timbermaw... Perhaps these things have something to do with the flask you found, ⟦19⟧.
rows.quest:5084:details:1: BThere is a large group of furbolg just past Timbermaw Hold, in ⟦E10⟧. Called the ⟦E9⟧ tribe, they have been corrupted and driven mad by the fel. Why don't you look around there and see if you can find any evidence of dealings between the Winterfall and the ⟦E9⟧?
rows.quest:5084:completion:0: Inside the cauldron bubbles a rotting, repulsive-smelling substance...
rows.quest:5085:obj:0: Report back to Donova Snowden with your findings.
rows.quest:5085:details:0: The greenish substance inside the cauldron appears to be similar to what you found in the flask. This strange gooey stuff could be as corrupted as the furbolg that created it...
rows.quest:5085:details:1: BIf the Winterfall furbolg are using it, does this mean that they will soon be as corrupted as the ⟦E9⟧ tribe?
rows.quest:5085:details:2: BIt would be best to report back to Donova with your findings, along with a sample of the liquid in the cauldron.
rows.quest:5085:completion:0: You are very resourceful, ⟦20⟧. Do you think that the Winterfall furbolgs have been to the ⟦E9⟧ camp?
rows.quest:5086:obj:0: Collect 3 Toxic Horror Droplets for Donova Snowden in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:5086:details:0: I've studied the sample you returned with, and while I can't say for sure, I believe it contains traces of toxic elements. However, the only way to know for sure is to gather some as a comparison.
rows.quest:5086:details:1: BI believe that the ⟦E9⟧ furbolg may be gathering these elements from other corrupted creatures in ⟦E10⟧; in particular, the elementals living in the Irontree Woods, called toxic horrors.
rows.quest:5086:details:2: BCollect a few samples for me to compare, but be careful -- it's very dangerous there!
rows.quest:5086:completion:0: I have to compare this to the substance you found in the cauldron, and then I'm sure we'll know more.
rows.quest:5087:obj:0: Find the Winterfall Runners and stop them from delivering their shipment to Winterfall Village.
rows.quest:5087:details:1: BWhen this toxic substance is mixed with the water from the hot springs, it loses its toxicity, only retaining the ability to temporarily affect those that ingest it. This must be why the Winterfall protect the hot springs so fervently -- they need them to purify their firewater.
rows.quest:5087:details:2: BWe need to stop this -- cut off contact between the Winterfall and the ⟦E9⟧. A group of runners walks the distance between their village and ⟦E10⟧. Find and defeat them, and steal their shipment.
rows.quest:5087:completion:0: <Donova examines the contents of the crate>
rows.quest:5087:completion:1: BI wonder if consuming this substance makes the furbolg more aggressive. They do seem much larger...
rows.quest:5121:obj:0: Donova Snowden in ⟦E2⟧ wants you to defeat High Chief Winterfall.
rows.quest:5121:details:0: While we still know very little about why the furbolg have been ingesting this strange substance, I do think it's best that we put a stop to it before it gets out of hand.
rows.quest:5121:details:1: BThe Winterfall furbolg are not a normally aggressive tribe, and this change in their behavior leads me to think that they must be under orders from their chief. We most likely can't undo the damage that has already been done, but I think that if their leader is slain, they will not get any worse.
rows.quest:5121:completion:0: Thank you so much, ⟦22⟧. I hope to get back to my studies without worry that I will be ambushed. Please accept this as a reward.
rows.quest:5123:obj:0: Bring the Crudely-written Log to Donova Snowden in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:5123:details:0: The log you found on the high chief looks extensive, but after looking through a couple of the pages, you find that you cannot read the text. The markings are so crude and poorly-formed that you are not sure if anyone would be able to read them.
rows.quest:5123:details:1: BBut perhaps Donova will be able to tell you what it says...
rows.quest:5123:completion:0: I wonder what all of this means... I can't make anything out...
rows.quest:5124:obj:0: Bring Malyfous Darkhammer 6 Enchanted Thorium Bars, 2 Essence of ⟦E11⟧, and 4 Star Rubies. You will also need to turn in your Unfired Plate Gauntlets.
rows.quest:5124:details:2: BMore importantly, are you willing to part with them? Naturally, I would pay you for such a noble gesture.
rows.quest:5124:details:3: BI'll tell you what, ⟦23⟧. If you give me those unfired gauntlets, I will teach you how to make a set all your own. All you need to do is collect the parts for me so that I may narrow down the exact recipe.
rows.quest:5124:details:5: BHere's the list of what I need, I'll front the non-enchanted thorium myself since you're supplying the gauntlets.⟦24⟧
rows.quest:5124:completion:0: As promised, ⟦25⟧, here's your recipe! I'm also going to throw in a little something extra for all of your hard work and dedication. What am I going to do with these anyway???
rows.quest:5126:obj:0: Speak with Lorax. Listen to what he has to say.⟦26⟧
rows.quest:5126:details:0: The Satyr paces about and talks to himself. Do you wish to question him?
rows.quest:5128:obj:0: Take the Crudely-written Log to Kelek Skykeeper in southern ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:5128:details:0: The Winterfall are no longer a threat to me, but if you still want to find out what was driving the furbolg to create and consume this strange firewater, I think you should seek out Kelek Skykeeper.
rows.quest:5128:details:1: BHe is part of a group known as the Emerald Circle, druids that are committed to their work in ⟦E10⟧, healing the land from the corruption.
rows.quest:5128:details:2: BKelek has much experience with the furbolgs in ⟦E10⟧, and may be able to tell you more about the log.
rows.quest:5128:completion:0: Yes, if you let me examine this for a while, I might be able to translate it for you.
rows.quest:5128:completion:2: BWhen I am able to look over this fully, I will send word to you.
rows.quest:5128:completion:3: BThank you for sharing this with me, ⟦29⟧. Very little is known about the Winterfall furbolg.
rows.quest:5161:obj:0: Speak with Haleh if you wish to continue.
rows.quest:5161:details:0: We understand what the cursed brood of ⟦E12⟧ attempts to do and we know that it cannot be allowed.
rows.quest:5161:details:1: BBecause of the protection Blackrock mountain affords ⟦E13⟧, it has become increasingly difficult for us to intercede.
rows.quest:5161:details:2: BWe can, however, empower you, mortal - should you so choose.
rows.quest:5161:details:3: BThe path before you is one full of peril. You must decide whether to accept our help. Ponder this and speak with me again when a decision has been made.
rows.quest:5163:obj:0: Take ⟦E3⟧'s Mechanical Yeti and scare her friends with it:
rows.quest:5163:obj:1: BLegacki in ⟦E1⟧ (⟦E2⟧)⟦30⟧Sprinkle in Gadgetzan (⟦E14⟧)⟦31⟧Quixxil in Marshal's Refuge (⟦E15⟧)
rows.quest:5163:obj:2: BWhen you are done, bring the Mechanical Yeti back to ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:5163:details:1: BNow, I sent some mail to my friends already, telling them that I have a surprise for them. This is where you come in!
rows.quest:5163:details:2: BI'm going to give you my mechanical yeti, and you need to surprise them by paying each of my friends a visit, turning the yeti on and sending it towards them.
rows.quest:5163:details:3: B Once you have shown Legacki in ⟦E1⟧, Sprinkle in Gadgetzan, and Quixxil in Marshal's Refuge, come back and tell me what happened!
rows.quest:5163:details:4: BPlease bring my yeti back to me then, too.
rows.quest:5163:completion:0: Hah! They'll think twice before making fun of my ideas again!
rows.quest:5163:completion:1: BThanks for your help, ⟦33⟧. I couldn't have had so much fun without you!
rows.quest:5244:obj:0: Speak with Jaron Stoneshaper in Starfall Village.
rows.quest:5244:details:0: The story behind Kel'Theril is one of a cursed race, bound to the place where they attempted an unfortunate ritual...
rows.quest:5244:details:1: BThe highborne that you will find there once stole a sacred artifact, believing that they could siphon its power for themselves, becoming even more powerful. In their efforts, the relic shattered in a huge explosion, driving the pieces below the ice of the lake...
rows.quest:5244:details:2: BSpeak with Jaron Stoneshaper if you'd like to learn more; he has recently visited the area and can tell you more.
rows.quest:5244:completion:0: Well, sure, I can tell you more about Kel'Theril. Mind you now, I'm no historian, but I can tell ya about what I saw there...
rows.quest:5245:obj:0: Use Jaron's Pick to find the four Highborne Relic Fragments. Bring them to Aurora Skycaller in ⟦E16⟧.
rows.quest:5245:details:0: The highborne spirits are miserable creatures, that's for sure. They are still searching for pieces of the very thing that has cursed them to Kel'Theril forever -- the stolen relic.
rows.quest:5245:details:1: BIf you are that interested, take my pick and go south to the lake, see if you can gather the pieces of it from within the ice.
rows.quest:5245:details:2: BNow, I can't tell you a thing about what you find, but I do know of someone who might... Aurora Skycaller; she dwells near the Northpass Tower in the northern part of ⟦E16⟧.
rows.quest:5245:completion:0: The past of the high elves is something that I do not wish to discuss, ⟦34⟧. Please, it pains me to think of all that has happened... And that there is no way to make things right.
rows.quest:5252:obj:0: Speak with Wynd Nightchaser in Starfall Village, and ask about the proper place for the Crystal of Zin-Malor.
rows.quest:5252:details:1: BThe highborne here are clouded by their own misssery...
rows.quest:5252:details:2: BI am sorrrrrowful, but I realize the errorrrr of what happened so long ago. Even though there is no waaaay to change the past, I am now at peacccce knowing that you have recovered the crystal of Zin-Malor...
rows.quest:5252:completion:0: Is that... what I think it is?
rows.quest:5253:obj:0: Deliver the Crystal of Zin-Malor to Arch ⟦E7⟧ Fandral Staghelm in ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:5253:details:1: BThe crystal of Zin-Malor can never be returned to the temple which, as you know, lies in ruin. But I believe that your effort to undo the evil of the past should not go unrewarded.
rows.quest:5253:details:2: BSeek out Arch ⟦E7⟧ Fandral Staghelm in ⟦E8⟧, and bring the crystal to him, ⟦36⟧. It should be in the hands of those that will not abuse its power. From the looks of it, only a handful of the strongest magic users would be able to control such a power.
rows.quest:5253:completion:0: I have heard of the Crystal of Zin-Malor; the user of the crystal becomes capable of incredible arcane power, but only if truly worthy. I am impressed that you not only recovered the crystal, but you also realize your own limits, and did not attempt to use the crystal yourself.
rows.quest:5253:completion:1: BThank you for bringing it to me, ⟦37⟧. We will keep it safe, and may the cursed sprits that once guarded the shattered crystal finally be at peace.
rows.quest:6028:obj:0: Deliver the ⟦E1⟧ Report to Argent Officer Pureheart at Chillwind Camp, ⟦E17⟧.
rows.quest:6028:details:0: I am looking for a responsible individual to aid me in a small but nonetheless important matter. I'm here as a representative of the Argent Dawn's interests to the local governance of ⟦E1⟧. I need to get a progress report to Argent Officer Pureheart at Chillwind Camp; it's a ways from here, located along the southern fringe of the ⟦E17⟧.
rows.quest:6028:details:1: BIf I may be so bold - this would be a perfect means to introduce yourself to my superior and perhaps earn some work from her!
rows.quest:6028:completion:0: Very resourceful, Gregor is. He's been dealing with the Steamwheedle Cartel for some time now, and has become an expert on the "art" of goblin negotiations. Though it's true that the goblins' primary loyalties lie with those who have the largest coin purses, they also know and respect the value of diplomacy. If anything, it provides them with repeat customers...
rows.quest:6028:completion:1: BAt any rate, the Argent Dawn acknowledges you for your effort. Please have this, with our thanks.
rows.quest:6029:obj:0: Deliver the ⟦E1⟧ Report to Argent Officer Garush at the Bulwark, ⟦E17⟧.
rows.quest:6029:details:0: I'm looking for a responsible individual to aid me in a small but nonetheless important matter. I'm here as a representative of the Argent Dawn's interests to the local governance of ⟦E1⟧. I need to get a progress report to Argent Officer Garush at the Bulwark; it's a ways from here, located along the western fringe of the ⟦E17⟧, east of ⟦E18⟧.
rows.quest:6029:details:1: BIf I may be so bold - this would be a perfect means to introduce yourself to my superior and perhaps earn some work from him!
rows.quest:6029:completion:0: Resourceful for a human, Gregor is. He's been dealing with the Steamwheedle Cartel for some time now, and has become an expert on the "art" of goblin negotiations. Though it's true that the goblins' primary loyalties lie with those who have the largest coin purses, they also know and respect the value of diplomacy. If anything, it provides them with repeat customers...
rows.quest:6029:completion:1: BAt any rate, the Argent Dawn acknowledges you for your effort. Please have this, with our thanks.
rows.quest:6030:obj:0: Deliver the book, "Studies in Spirit Speaking", to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff at Light's ⟦E19⟧ Chapel, ⟦E16⟧.
rows.quest:6030:details:0: A recluse medium found in these parts by the name of Umbranse has provided the Argent Dawn with quite a literary masterpiece... one that amounts to quite possibly the largest collection of jibber-jabber I've ever seen written.
rows.quest:6030:details:1: BOne of the Dawn's most respected leaders, Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff, is a brilliant linguist. Could you take this to him for me - for a reward, of course? Light's ⟦E19⟧ Chapel - that's where he's currently at, far in the eastern part of the ⟦E16⟧.
rows.quest:6030:completion:0: This... this is a very special book you have brought me. I'd like to tell you that "special" in this case means "unique and quite possibly illuminating", but that remains to be seen.
rows.quest:6030:completion:1: B"Ooooooo?" Who in their right mind thinks this up?
rows.quest:6030:completion:2: BWell now, I've heard of this Umbranse that Gregor spoke of, so this isn't without merit. I'll do my best to decipher it. As for you... please, have this - courtesy of the Argent Dawn. While you are here, perhaps there are some other things you can aid us with.
rows.quest:6603:obj:0: Find Donova Snowden near the hot springs in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:6603:details:1: BWhy, sure, I spend some time out in the wilds and know about these things... I'm always mighty proud to say it. I consider the hours I spend out there in the hills to be golden. Help you cultivate quick reflexes, a cool head and a keen eye...
rows.quest:6603:details:2: BIt takes judgement, brains and maturity to appreciate the wilderness in the way that I do.
rows.quest:6603:details:3: BNow, what was I talking about?
rows.quest:6603:details:4: BAh yes, trouble. See Donova Snowden at the hot springs and she can tell you more.
rows.quest:6603:completion:0: Well, hi there! So Meggi told you of the trouble I have found here?
rows.quest:6604:obj:0: Speak with Jaron Stoneshaper at Starfall Village.
rows.quest:6604:details:0: Have you noticed the abandoned camp to the south of here? It looks like the wildkin went crazy and destroyed just about everything they could find!
rows.quest:6604:details:1: BI heard a rumor that one of the survivors of the attack is resting at Starfall Village, west of here. I'm sure curious about what happened... aren't you?
rows.quest:6604:completion:0: Aye, what can I do for you?
